messages:
maya: Heads-up — ops is kicking off a rolling infra maintenance in us-west in ~10m. There will be a partial pager blackout for non-critical alerts while hosts drain. tagging primary/secondary now.

linh: copying — i'm primary for the 22:00-06:00 shift. aj is secondary.

aj: i'll be on standby. if anything looks customer-impacting i'll take it.

support-ops: maintenance window: us-west-gpu-pool drain + kernel patch, expected 12-18min per AZ. We'll mark degraded during drain. link: https://internal.ops/maint/3176543210

maya: important: incident-bot will suppress sev3/4 non-customer-facing alerts for the duration; sev1/2 and customer-facing sev3 still page. follow the escalation matrix if page comes in.

sre-bot: [ALERT SUPPRESSION] Non-critical alerts suppressed on tags: pool:us-west, role:batch. Suppression ID: sup-31765. Duration: 20m.

linh: quick checklist: if you get paged for "high-queue-latency" route to runbook -> /runbooks/queue-latency, check `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep Evicted` then notify eng-lead if >3 worker pods evicted.

aj: noted. can someone post the exact pager rota fallback? i.e., if both primary and secondary are unreachable.

maya: fallback: oncall-schedule -> bridge -> if no ack in 5m escalate to eng-lead. if eng-lead doesn't ack in 10m, page SRE pager (on-call rotation). Full text: 
```
1) Primary (linh) page 1m
2) Secondary (aj) page 2m
3) Eng-lead page 5m
4) SRE pager/rotation page 10m
5) Exec on-call only for SEV1 beyond 30m
```

linh: adding runbook pointer for customer-impact triage: /runbooks/customer-impact. steps: preserve logs (s3://redwood-logs/incident/3176543210), tag incident with customer list from support-ops.

support-ops: we flagged two customers on VIP list who run in us-west — @eng-lead will want to know if any of their requests returned 5xx.

eng-lead: thanks. i'll be alert. please attach traces if you see >1% error rate over 1m. Use this datadog query: `avg(last_1m):sum:requests.errors{region:us-west} / sum:requests.count{region:us-west} > 0.01`

aj: just got a page for "inference-proxy 503" — i'm taking.

aj: checking proxy logs: `kubectl logs --since=5m -l app=inference-proxy -n prod | grep 503` — seeing spikes from host ip 10.12.4.7, looks like connection reset during drain.

linh: mark customer-impacting? support-ops: any support tickets correlating?

support-ops: two open chats from VIP customers reporting intermittent timeouts since 22:01. marking customer-impact = yes.

aj: escalating to eng-lead per matrix. paging now. @eng-lead please confirm whether to open incident channel.

eng-lead: open incident channel please — create #incident-3176543210, short description: us-west rolling maintenance causing proxy 503s impacting VIP customers. set severity = sev2.

sre-bot: [BRIDGE CREATED] #incident-3176543210 created by eng-lead. Join for coordination.

maya: reminder: because of the maintenance we have reduced capacity; mitigation path: 1) take host 10.12.4.7 out of service, 2) bump proxy timeout to 30s as temporary measure, 3) enable fallback routing to us-east for VIP customers.

aj: applying temporary proxy timeout bump: `kubectl edit cm proxy-config -n prod` -> set `timeout: 30s`. patch applied.

linh: i'm updating the handoff note: tonight's primary remains linh until 06:00, but because of this event aj will take lead on remediation for the next 30m. leaving note in /hand-offs/2026-03-14.

aj: confirming fallback routing enabled for VIP customers via feature-flag `vip-fallback-us-east=true`. Pinging support-ops to notify affected customers.

support-ops: notified customers and created ticket INC-2026-542 with status "mitigated: fallback enabled".

eng-lead: good. once we confirm error rate <0.5% for 5m we'll close the incident and resume normal suppression policies.

aj: error rate at 0.8% now after timeout bump and fallback. continue to watch.

linh: taking note for post-mortem: make sure handoff docs include explicit fallback flag and exact pager escalation times for blackout windows. this gap caused extra manual coordination.

maya: agreed — action item: update oncall runbook by EOD. assigning to @linh.

linh: i'll update runbook and post PR to ops-runbooks repo.

sre-bot: [ALERT SUPPRESSION END] sup-31765 cleared — maintenance window ended.

aj: looks stable: error rate 0.2% over last 5m. closing incident on my end, moving notes to #incidents-log.

eng-lead: thanks team. retro item: consider shorter suppression windows or targeted suppression tags so customer-facing alerts still route to primary even during ops work.

maya: +1. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
